en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, from his father, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu’l-Jaroud, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, that he said:
The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Everyone who is to be judged, is to be tormented.
Then a sayer said to him: O Messenger of Allah, then where is the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «then he will be judged an easy judgement» [84:8]?
He said: That refers to turning away (from questioning). [1] It means pardoning.
